create_SimpleRLEnv_instance: create a SimpleRLEnv instance with a Habitat Config and optional Dataset for RL training
get_reward_range: get the reward range which returns negative infinity to positive infinity for the RL environment
get_reward_from_observations: get the reward value from observations using the configured REWARD_MEASURE metric from environment metrics
get_done_from_observations: get the done signal by checking if the episode is over or the SUCCESS_MEASURE metric is true
get_info_from_observations: get all environment metrics as a dictionary from the current observations for monitoring and logging
